summary: Backend-only re-test of the collage_url shape fix. Updated /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py to assert that `collage_url` is host-relative (starts with `/api/static/collages/`, contains no `http://`/`https://`/hostname, and filename equals `{collage_id}.png`). Also verified that concatenating `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL + collage_url` returns HTTP 200 with content-type `image/png` and PNG dims 1080x1920. Ran the full pytest suite (13 tests): all passed in ~75s.
critical_code_review_comments: static_url() helper is clean and reusable. Note: `/api/static` is mounted via app.mount BEFORE the api_router include — this is correct so the ingress `/api/*` routing continues to hit the backend for collage image GETs (verified by 200 image/png fetch through REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL).
seed_data_creation: Reused /tmp/test_photo_{1..5}.jpg from previous iteration. One real invite email sent to sayanbhatt2005@gmail.com.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tests now assert collage_url is host-relative and matches `/api/static/collages/{collage_id}.png`. Reachability is verified by prepending REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Coverage: all 6 templates (URL shape) + polaroid+magazine (reachability) + validation (2/6 photos, bad template) + email invite regression + invalid email 422. All 13 tests pass.
rca_of_the_issue: Previously the endpoint built an absolute URL from `request.base_url` which resolved to the internal cluster hostname (unreachable externally). Fix introduces `static_url()` returning a host-relative path so clients can resolve it against whichever base host they used to reach the API. Verified across all 6 templates.
